title: 2021 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 3 套）

analysis.topic: 云南省的自然与人文概况
analysis.reference: Yunnan is a province located in the southwest of China, with an average altitude of 1,500 meters. It has a long history, spectacular scenery, and a pleasant climate. Boasting a superior ecological environment and rich biodiversity, Yunnan is hailed as a paradise for wild animals and plants. Moreover, it is endowed with a variety of mineral resources and abundant water resources, which provide favorable conditions for the sustainable development of the province's economy. Yunnan is home to 25 ethnic minorities, most of whom have their own languages, customs, and religions. The unique natural landscapes and diverse ethnic cultures make Yunnan one of the most popular tourist destinations in China, attracting a large number of domestic and international tourists every year.

sentences.cn: 云南是位于中国西南的一个省份，平均海拔1500米。
sentences.en: Yunnan is a province located in the southwest of China, with an average altitude of 1,500 meters.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构 + 过去分词短语作后置定语 + with 介词短语补充说明海拔信息
keys: 位于中国西南 located in the southwest of China

sentences.cn: 云南历史悠久，风景秀丽，气候宜人。
sentences.en: It has a long history, spectacular scenery, and a pleasant climate.
sentences.structure: 主谓宾结构，三个并列宾语，将中文三个短句合并为一句英文
keys: 历史悠久 a long history
气候宜人 a pleasant climate

sentences.cn: 云南生态环境优越，生物多种多样，被誉为野生动植物的天堂。
sentences.en: Boasting a superior ecological environment and rich biodiversity, Yunnan is hailed as a paradise for wild animals and plants.
sentences.structure: 现在分词短语作原因状语 + 被动语态主句，前半句用分词短语整合，主句突出'被誉为'
keys: 生物多种多样 rich biodiversity
野生动植物 wild animals and plants

sentences.cn: 云南还有多种矿藏和充足的水资源，为全省经济的可持续发展提供了有利条件。
sentences.en: Moreover, it is endowed with a variety of mineral resources and abundant water resources, which provide favorable conditions for the sustainable development of the province's economy.
sentences.structure: 被动语态主句 + which 引导的非限制性定语从句，后半句用定语从句衔接因果逻辑
keys: 充足的水资源 abundant water resources

sentences.cn: 云南居住着25个少数民族，他们大多有自己的语言、习俗和宗教。
sentences.en: Yunnan is home to 25 ethnic minorities, most of whom have their own languages, customs, and religions.
sentences.structure: be home to 句型 + most of whom 引导的非限制性定语从句，避免逐字翻译'居住着'

sentences.cn: 云南独特的自然景色和丰富的民族文化使其成为中国最受欢迎的旅游目的地之一，每年都吸引着大批国内外游客前往观光旅游。
sentences.en: The unique natural landscapes and diverse ethnic cultures make Yunnan one of the most popular tourist destinations in China, attracting a large number of domestic and international tourists every year.
sentences.structure: make + 宾语 + 宾补结构 + 现在分词短语作结果状语，主句用使役动词，末尾用分词短语收束
keys: 国内外游客 domestic and international tourists

pitfalls: '平均海拔1500米'中数字与单位搭配易写错，应为 an average altitude of 1,500 meters
'被誉为'常被误译为 be called，应使用 be hailed/honored/reputed as 更地道
'居住着25个少数民族'若直译为 live 会导致主语混乱，宜用 be home to 句型
'使其成为……之一'中 one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 结构常遗漏复数
'矿藏'误译为 mines（矿井），正确应为 mineral resources/mineral deposits

upgrades.plain: Yunnan has a good ecological environment
upgrades.note: 用现在分词短语作状语，句式更紧凑，避免主语重复

upgrades.better: Yunnan is endowed with a variety of mineral resources
upgrades.note: be endowed with 表示天然拥有，比 have 更书面、更贴合自然资源语境

upgrades.better: Yunnan is home to 25 ethnic minorities
upgrades.note: be home to 是描述某地居住群体的地道表达，避免生硬直译

upgrades.plain: which makes it one of the most popular places for tourism
upgrades.better: making it one of the most popular tourist destinations
upgrades.note: 用现在分词作结果状语更简洁，tourist destination 比 place for tourism 更专业

upgrades.plain: Yunnan has a long history. It has beautiful scenery. The climate is pleasant.
upgrades.better: It has a long history, spectacular scenery, and a pleasant climate.
upgrades.note: 将三个并列短句合并为一句，用并列宾语结构体现英文信息整合能力
